# fin.tiered_rates

An immutable amount-banded rate table, such as a savings ladder.

## Overview

`fin.tiered_rates` is owned by the [`fin`](../stdlib/fin.md) module (see [Rate and charge
tables](../stdlib/fin.md#rate-and-charge-tables) for what the four tables share). It is built from a one-line text
form or from band records:

| text form | band record |
| --- | --- |
| `"0:0.005, 1000:0.007, 10000:0.009"` — from 0, open at the top | `{from, rate}` |

`rule` is `"whole"` (the band the amount lands in applies to all of it) or `"marginal"` (each slice at its own band's
rate).

<a id="accrue"></a>
### `accrue(principal, f, rule, scale, mode) -> decimal`

Answer the interest on `principal` over a year fraction `f`.

<a id="at"></a>
### `at(amount) -> record`

Answer the band `amount` falls in, as `{from, rate}`.

<a id="bands"></a>
### `bands() -> array`

Answer the bands as records in constructor shape, so the table rebuilds from them: `fin.tiered_rates(t.bands()) == t`.

<a id="charge"></a>
### `charge(amount, rule, scale, mode) -> decimal`

Answer the charge on `amount` under `rule`, rounded once.

```go
fin := import("fin")
tr := fin.tiered_rates("0:0.005, 1000:0.007, 10000:0.009")
tr.charge(15000, "whole", 2, "half_even")       // => 135.00d — all of it at the 10000 band's rate
tr.charge(15000, "marginal", 2, "half_even")    // => 113.00d — 5.00 + 63.00 + 45.00
```

<a id="charge_parts"></a>
### `charge_parts(amount, rule, scale, mode) -> array`

Answer each band's slice of the charge, as `[{from, to, rate, fixed, amount}]`; see [`charge`](#charge).

<a id="copy"></a>
### `copy() -> fin.tiered_rates`

Answer the table itself — it is immutable.

<a id="rate"></a>
### `rate(amount, rule, scale, mode) -> decimal`

Answer the applied rate (blended under `"marginal"`) — for statements, not postings.
